Lucy dreams of something a little more traditional, so can this groom win her over by taking on her favourite love story?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.sub-title: The One with the Fisherman's Wedding
programme.desc: Harry, 24, and his 28-year-old fiancée Mel live in a beautiful seaside village called Manorbier on the Pembrokeshire coast in south Wales. So, does Harry put his love of the sea before the love of his life? With a bride that finds it hard to trust him, will he get led astray? Can this fisherman really give this land-loving girl the wedding of her dreams?

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: When Maaco President Jose Costa goes undercover, he gets overheated after finding an employee is cutting corners.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Phenix Salon Inc founder Gina Rivera must complete a pedicure and a straight-razor shave while undercover.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay is in Easton, Pennsylvania, to visit struggling Italian restaurant Bella Luna. Rosaria bought the establishment to realise her son Gianfranco's ambition to become a chef.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying & Selling
programme.desc: Nicole and Matt bought their starter home before they had three kids, and they've long since outgrown their space and desperately need more room. Jonathan steps in to overhaul the property's tired interiors.

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In north London, Helen and her outspoken boyfriend David, Vicky and her partner Geoff, and Sara and her husband Thierry compete in a week featuring the fashions and food of the 1980s.

programme.title: Taskmaster Bleeped
programme.desc: Sophie Willan shouts the name of a body part in Alex Horne's flustered face. John Robins demonstrates the power of his forearms. And can Joanne McNally act out the word 'beer'?

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the panel game with Sean Lock and Bill Bailey, who take on special guest captain Joe Wilkinson with Isy Suttie. Susie Dent is joined by Joe Lycett in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters.

programme.title: Friday Night Dinner
programme.desc: The Goodmans are a family who have made an art form of their eccentricities. In this first episode, mum and dad are having a clear-out, but dad is reluctant to chuck away all his old magazines roping in Jonny to secretly hide the stash back at his flat. Later, Dad has forgotten to come and pick up their old sofa bed and as they carry it downstairs, it gets stuck on the staircase.

programme.title: Friday Night Dinner
programme.desc: When Adam and Jonny come home to find Dad secretly peering into his underpants with a magnifying glass, they're desperate to find out what he's looking at. Meanwhile, Mum is just trying to have a nice Friday night, but Jim - the neighbour who's terrified of his own dog - keeps interrupting the meal. Dad takes Adam - who's single - into the toilet to have a private chat about 'females'.

programme.title: Peep Show
programme.desc: Despite being bullied on the street by the local children, Mark sets himself the task of sleeping with the divorcee, Toni, next door. Toni hosts a party at which Mark fails in his attempt to seduce her when he talks about the Battle of Stalingrad.

programme.title: Peep Show
programme.desc: Jeremy's band is going nowhere, so he reluctantly agrees to go for a job working in Mark's office. Meanwhile, Mark's attempts to flirt with Sophie backfire when he accidentally leads her to believe that he's a Nazi.

programme.title: Tattoo Fixers: Extreme
programme.desc: Sketch tucks away Andy's massive mishap, Alice cleans up Sam's idiotic inking, while Uzzi and Pash team up to tackle Joe's gigantic and sleazy slogan. Pash creates a new design for car crash survivor Debbie.
